 FLAVIO LOPES / TNN / Nov 18, 2026, 23:41 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Dempo will look to improve their finishing after creating numerous chances in the last three games Panaji: Dempo SC are keen to put their recent setback behind as they host unbeaten Shillong Lajong FC in the top-three showdown of Indian Football League at Nehru Stadium, Fatorda, on Thursday, 4pm. Third-placed Dempo (6 pts) will look to bounce back after conceding a late goal in their 1-2 defeat against Chanmari FC. However, Lajong (7 pts) are high on confidence as they sit second in the standings with two wins and a draw. League leaders Gokulam Kerala FC (9 pts) and Chanmari FC, who have played only two games, are the only other sides yet to taste defeat. The league is still in its early stages with just three rounds completed, but Thursdays result could shape the battle for the top spot. "Teams in the league are trying to win the championship, because they all have a good squad. They are all trying to go to the top division (ISL)," Dempo head coach Samir Naik told TOI during Wednesday's media interaction. In the last game, despite taking an early lead through Laximanrao Rane, Dempo conceded a first-half equaliser and conceded in the stoppage time. The five-time national champions will look to tighten their defence and focus where it matters most. They have no injury concerns and will look to go all out against Lajong. "If we are missing anyone, there are no issues because I have equally strong replacements. The team is shaping very nicely. Some players are taking a little time to adjust, but we are doing our best," said Samir. Dempo's main concern remains finishing after creating a number of chances in the last three games. "We played a really good game, but we lost focus in some situations and conceded goals. We are getting stronger, we have trained really hard, and we will do better in the next match," said Dempo's young midfielder Arnold Oliveira. On the other hand, the Meghalaya side arrive with an impressive 2-1 home victory against Sreenidi Deccan FC last week. Join conversation

 Lajong head coach Birendra Thapa praised his team's unbeaten start while cautioning against complacency against a familiar foe. "Team preparation is good. After the last match against Sreenidi, the team is looking in good shape, and Dempo have always been a tough opponent for us," said Thapa. Dempo had trounced Lajong 3-0 last season in the same fixture. However, the teams played out a goalless draw in their last meeting in Lajong. "Consistency is very important when you're playing in this league. I am very satisfied with the performance till now, being three matches unbeaten. We have to improve in the final third, the finishing part, which will come," said Thapa.
